fresh_fixed: scene 1: 'GTA 6 aaj raat se khel sakte ho' implies it is not yet playable, but it is release day (Nov 19, 2026) -> The game is launching today/is available.
scene 2: 'PS5 Xbox pe midnight se live' implies it is not yet live, but it is Nov 19 -> The game is live/releasing today.

scene 8: 'Reviews 10/10 IGN GameSpot Eurogamer' -> The sources do not confirm these specific review scores (IGN, GameSpot, Eurogamer, GamesRadar) as 10/10 or 5/5; they mention a review by Vice calling it 'Rockstar’s Magnum Opus' but do not provide these specific aggregate scores.
scene 9: 'Pre-order bonus abhi mil raha' -> Since the game is launching/released today, pre-order bonuses are typically no longer available for purchase, as the game is now in its release phase.
